title: Smoky Shrimp, Tomato, and Whole Grain Stew
intro: Smoked paprika and a splash of sherry vinegar deliver the savory depth of a classic Spanish seafood stew without the excess saturated fat. Adding a ready-to-eat grain pouch directly into the simmering broth builds a hearty, thick texture instantly.

ingredients.name: Frozen bell pepper and onion blend
Low-sodium vegetable broth
ingredients.canonical_name: Soup, vegetable broth, ready to serve, low sodium

ingredients.name: No-salt-added diced tomatoes
ingredients.canonical_name: Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice, no salt added

ingredients.name: Ready-to-eat brown rice and quinoa pouch
Frozen pre-cooked shrimp (untreated / no salt added)
ingredients.canonical_name: Crustaceans, shrimp, mixed species, cooked, moist heat

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a medium pot over medium-high heat. Add the frozen pepper and onion blend, and sauté until softened, 3 to 4 minutes.
Stir in the smoked paprika and garlic powder. Cook until fragrant, about 30 seconds.

Pour in the vegetable broth and diced tomatoes with their juices. Bring to a rolling boil over medium-high heat, reduce the heat to low, and simmer until the tomatoes break down slightly, 5 to 6 minutes.
Stir the brown rice and quinoa into the simmering broth. Cook until the grains absorb some of the liquid and warm through, 2 to 3 minutes.
Fold in the thawed shrimp and sherry vinegar. Simmer until the shrimp are hot and opaque, 1 to 2 minutes.
Remove the pot from the heat immediately to prevent the shrimp from overcooking. Stir in the parsley and portion the stew into warm bowls.
variation: Trade the shrimp for diced, roasted chicken breast pieces.
conservation: Keeps 2 days refrigerated; reheat gently on the stovetop.
